feature_name: Spanner change streams to Pub/Sub Dataflow template
summary: Spanner adds a Dataflow template that streams change stream records from Spanner and writes them to Pub/Sub topics.

evidence_snippets: For Spanner change streams, we provide three Dataflow flex templates: Spanner change streams to BigQuery Spanner change streams to Google Cloud Storage Spanner change streams to Pub/Sub The following restrictions apply when you use the Spanner change streams to Pub/Sub template: Pub/Sub has a 10 MB message size limitation.
We also provide a Dataflow template for this use case: see Connect change streams to Cloud Storage .
We also provide a Dataflow template for this use case; see Connect change streams to BigQuery .

supporting_pages.title: Change streams overview \_|\_ Spanner \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Google provides templates that let you rapidly build Dataflow pipelines for common change stream use cases, including sending all of a stream's data changes to a BigQuery dataset, or copying them to a Cloud Storage bucket .
Reading change streams Spanner offers multiple ways to read a change stream's data: Through Dataflow, using the Apache Beam SpannerIO connector.
For a more detailed overview of how change streams and Dataflow work together, see Build change streams connections with Dataflow .
